messages:
Maria: Heads up — noticed a spike in "time to owner" for inbound leads in the last 2h. ~15% of leads are sitting >3m. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/lead-handoff
James: On it. Seeing many leads in 'pending_enrichment' state. HubSpot shows webhook retries for the enrichment callback.
Alexa: We recently added a debounce window in the RR worker to avoid duplicate claims — default is 120s. Could be interacting badly with webhook timing.
Rahul: Likely a race: RR worker polls contacts; if contact.enriched == false it requeues for claim_delay. Enrichment webhook does an upsert + owner assignment. If RR requeues before webhook, owner end up not set for a while.
Priya: Quick triage idea: reduce RR `claim_delay` from 120s -> 30s and add a short grace path that assigns to a default SDR after 2m if owner still null.
James: Query to find affected leads: `SELECT id, vid, created_at, owner_assigned_at FROM hubspot_contacts WHERE owner_assigned_at IS NULL AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'` — gives ~420 rows in the window.
Maria: SLA question — marketing SLAs say owner within 2m for high intent. This breach matters for ads conversion routing.
Rahul: Medium-term fix: change RR worker logic to be "optimistic claim": if contact.enriched==false but webhook is pending (recent webhook event timestamp < 30s), defer requeue slightly instead of full claim_delay. Also add idempotent backfill job.
Alexa: Short-term patch I can push: set claim_delay to 30s in staging and watch. Also add telemetry: tag requeues with reason (enrichment_pending vs no-owner).
Priya: I'll add a HubSpot workflow fallback: if `owner` is null and `enrichment_status` != "ready" after 120s, set `owner_pending:true` and fire an assign-to-default action. Steps: 1) create contact property owner_pending 2) workflow triggers when created_at + 120s and owner is unknown 3) assign to placeholder queue.
James: Can we avoid double-assigns? Webhook might set owner just after fallback. We'll need ownership precedence: webhook assignment should override placeholder but send notification to SDR about replacement.
Rahul: Good point — make placeholder assignments low-risk (no SF sync until confirmed) and let webhook finalise with upsert that supersedes placeholder.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary config update for `rr-worker.claim_delay=30` in infra/staging at 1845679120. Watch window 30m.
Maria: Action items: - Alexa reduce claim_delay in staging and run canary (Alexa) - Rahul add optimistic-check patch & backfill job (Rahul/PR) - Priya create HS workflow fallback and property (Priya) - James run ad-hoc SQL to export stuck leads and notify SDR queue (James) - Ops: add Datadog alert for >5% leads >2m to owner (Maria/ops)
Alexa: I'll post results in #marketing after the canary. If things are stable we'll push to prod and update runbook. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks team — let's try to get prod patch within the day. If anyone finds a different root cause ping me directly.
